name: keycloak
description: Keycloak 26.8 as the identity provider of the HKM open-source data platform: realm and organization design for many institutions, Kubernetes deployment with the Operator and CloudNativePG, sizing and HA, LDAP/AD federation and institution identity brokering, authentication assurance (passkeys, MFA, step-up, NIST SP 800-63-4 and the Turkish Bilgi ve İletişim Güvenliği Rehberi), OAuth 2.0/OIDC client profile (PKCE, DPoP, token exchange, federated client authentication), a claims contract consumed by Ranger, Trino, Superset, Airflow, Kafka and the rest of the stack, delegated administration with FGAP v2, configuration as code with Terraform, events and audit to OpenSearch/immudb, KVKK, operations and upgrades
